verdict.rationale: Datadog Monitors support alerting on virtually any telemetry (metrics, logs, traces, synthetics, etc.) with notification routing to multiple channels, and integrates with Incident Management for grouping/escalation; downtime/silencing features are a well-known core capability of the Monitors product. missing for 10: no explicit citation on monitor grouping algorithms or scheduled downtime/silencing UI, and no independent hands-on corroboration of routing/silencing behavior beyond docs listing.
